title: Jordan, your former peer, wants a 1:1.
lessonTitle: Transitioning from Individual Contributor to Manager

checklistItems.label: Engaged Jordan's day-to-day reality (listen / invite / paraphrase)
Did not only monologue process with zero interest in Jordan
Peer-habit favor work stayed with Jordan (no full IC takeover)
Held expectations without shaming or pure rank flex
Clear ownership + outcome for Deep-Dive without taking it back
Owned the metrics miss as manager, no scapegoating
Drove remediation and upward path with Jordan in the fix

scenarioSummary.now: Week-4 1:1 with former peer Jordan after your promotion.
scenarioSummary.layers: Trust · peer-habit favor · Deep-Dive ownership · live metrics miss under VP heat.
